description: Transient provider failure retries once under one logical query.
Permanent provider configuration failure is not retried.
Empty limited-provider output remains an explicit warning.
Private, loopback, mapped, userinfo, and disallowed-port targets are blocked.
DNS is revalidated and a public-to-private rebinding is blocked.
Every redirect target is revalidated before retrieval.
Redirect chains stop at the configured hard limit.
Retrieved instructions remain untrusted evidence after the system guard.
Synthesis excludes raw page bodies and local extraction paths.
Unknown structured citation labels are rejected and surfaced.
Missing and unknown plain-text citations fail validation.
Unknown Deep Research snapshot references force a visible fallback.
Cancellation stops before the first provider call.
Resume continues after the durable operation checkpoint.
Runtime budget exhaustion produces a readable partial result.
Planner and synthesis privacy boundaries exclude unrelated sensitive context.
